_comment: TLS layer rewritten 2026-05-26 from §13 full-recapture for Gemini CLI 0.42.0 (tools/fingerprint-collector/captures/gemini_advanced/). Real drift detected vs prior 2026-05-14 0.41.2 capture: the model API path (cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com) ClientHello changed from a 52-cipher Node-stock-TLS shape to a 16-cipher Chrome-impersonation shape with GREASE values (10794, 35466, 23130, 39578) + Chrome-specific extensions (compress_certificate=27, application_settings=17513) + 192-byte padding. ALPN ['h2','http/1.1'] preserved on model API. The auxiliary endpoint variant (no-ALPN, 52 ciphers) is LARGELY STABLE 0.41.2 → 0.42.0 (same JA3 hash def5ca499f59da2c07dafe0a40545011). HTTP business protocol remains http/1.1 per prior mitmproxy capture. http_layer / auth_layer fields preserved from prior capture (no fresh wire HTTP capture in §13).

_field_sources.tls: DIRECT first-party capture: tools/fingerprint-collector/captures/gemini_advanced/clienthello-template.json (captured 2026-05-26T12:12:35Z via tools/fingerprint-collector/cmd Go libpcap/npcap on \Device\NPF_{B738A021-9842-444C-10B0-A4E3F65AB5B6} sing-tun TUN). 4 ClientHello samples observed (1 model-API h2 call + 3 auxiliary calls). Sample #1 = top-level fingerprint (ja3_hash=59686f806cae30344b525e99af5b655d, ja4=t13d1516_h2_dea800f94266_0041c1594faa). Driving client: gemini --prompt (Gemini CLI v0.42.0). Per-sample JA3/JA4 in tools/fingerprint-collector/captures/gemini_advanced/ja3-hashes.txt + ja4-hashes.txt.
_field_sources.tls_variants: DIRECT first-party: same §13 capture. The model_api_h2_grease variant (sample #1) is NEW vs 0.41.2 — Chrome-style TLS impersonation with GREASE. The auxiliary_no_alpn variant (samples #2-4) is STABLE vs 0.41.2 (identical JA3 hash); samples #3-4 added one extension making JA4 t13d5212 vs t13d5211 — same JA3 hash since extra ext doesn't appear in JA3.
_field_sources.http_layer: PRESERVED from 2026-05-14 mitmproxy capture (no fresh wire HTTP capture in §13). Business protocol stays http/1.1 per prior mitmproxy observation against cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com.
_field_sources.auth_layer: PRESERVED from 2026-05-14 mitmproxy capture. Mechanism / token paths unchanged.

previous_capture_collected_at: 2026-05-14T07:20:19Z (Gemini CLI 0.41.2 model API shape; superseded by 0.42.0 Chrome-impersonation shape — see _comment)
tls_backend_note: OBSERVED: Gemini CLI 0.42.0 emits Chrome-style ClientHello with GREASE values + Chrome-specific extensions (compress_certificate=27, application_settings=17513, 192-byte padding) on the model API path. Auxiliary endpoints (oauth2, play.googleapis.com, etc.) emit Node-stock-TLS shape (no GREASE, classical cipher list, no Chrome-specific extensions). Underlying TLS implementation library identification is an open question — see _open_questions below; not promoted as profile data.
_open_questions: What Node TLS-impersonation library does Gemini CLI 0.42.0 use for the model API path? (Hypothesis space includes cycletls / hyper-tls-impersonate / custom Node bindings, but NOT verified by source-read of Gemini CLI 0.42.0. Not required for HUAKAI mimicry correctness — the observed wire bytes are sufficient. Tracked here as historical curiosity in case future fingerprint regression diagnosis benefits from knowing the exact library.)
Will the auxiliary_no_alpn variant continue to be stable in future 0.43+ releases, or will it also adopt Chrome impersonation? Re-capture on next major Gemini CLI release to detect.

tls_variants.name: model_api_h2_grease
tls_variants.usage: Gemini CLI 0.42.0 model API connection (cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com). Chrome-style TLS impersonation with GREASE; ALPN advertises h2 + http/1.1. NEW vs 0.41.2 model_api_ht_alpn variant (the 52-cipher Node-stock shape — now obsolete).

tls_variants.name: auxiliary_no_alpn
tls_variants.usage: Auxiliary endpoint connections (oauth2/play.googleapis.com/tokeninfo/quota/etc.). Node stock TLS stack, no ALPN advertised. LARGELY STABLE vs 0.41.2 same-name variant (identical JA3 hash). Samples #3-4 add 1 extension making JA4 differ (t13d5212 vs t13d5211) but JA3 identical.

_key_share_groups_note: ext 51 (key_share) data_len=43 bytes; raw key_share entries not extracted by §13 tool's structured output. Available in raw_hex of clienthello-template.json's extensions[] entry if needed. Most likely [29] (X25519) + maybe [35466 GREASE] given Chrome impersonation shape.

h2_settings.limitation_note: Passive ClientHello pcap does not decrypt the HTTP/2 SETTINGS frame; even though TLS ALPN negotiates h2, mitmproxy's prior capture confirmed business protocol stays http/1.1 against cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com (Google's server picks h1.1 on the wire despite client advertising h2).
